title: Glassstep Mimic
text: Glassstep Mimic repeats every footfall from the wrong direction until the route seems surrounded. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: The extra step is always closer.

defeatReward.text: Glassstep Mimic is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
